title: polypodium rigidum var. polyphyllum
intro: Polypodium rigidum var. polyphyllum, commonly known as the Chinese cinnamon fern or Polyphyllia, is a variety of plant that belongs to the Polypodium genus, a group of ferns native to China. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including the treatment of fever, cough, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Polypodium rigidum var. polyphyllum include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which help in reducing inflammation, fighting off infections, and protecting cells from oxidative damage. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, terpenoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
